name: action_control
description: Lets a player steer an entity with two actions, one per axis: move_x and move_y unless the entity names others (a second player on the same screen, a cursor and a character steered apart).

components.name: Controlled
components.description: The entity's Velocity follows the actions action_x and action_y (move_x and move_y when they are none), multiplied by speed. horizontal and vertical turn an axis off: the entity then leaves that part of its Velocity alone (a jumper steered left and right keeps vertical false, so gravity decides how it moves up and down). acceleration, when it is more than 0, makes the speed reach the asked one gradually instead of at once: it changes by at most acceleration units per second, every second (a character that takes a few steps to reach full speed). braking is the same when the speed has to go down or turn around (the action let go, or pushed the other way); 0 uses acceleration.

systems.name: steer
systems.description: Sets the Velocity of every Controlled entity from the current value of its two actions.
